capability.summary: Summarize `git blame --line-porcelain` as blamed-line counts grouped by author name
capability.description: Runs Git blame for one existing file from that file's directory, scans porcelain output for `author ` records, and returns only a total blamed-line count plus an author-to-line-count mapping ordered by frequency. It is a read-only aggregate, not a full blame report.
capability.problem_space: Coarse per-author line-count summarization for one Git-tracked file; not commit-history analysis, responsibility determination, per-line attribution retrieval, repository mutation, or branch cleanup.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing file path inside a discoverable Git repository; output: JSON with total blamed lines and counts grouped only by porcelain author name, or a Git/path error.
accepted_inputs: an existing file path for which `git blame` can discover a containing repository and produce blame data
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "git", file: string, total_lines: integer, lines_by_author: object}; lines_by_author maps author display names to blamed-line counts in descending `Counter.most_common()` order, and total_lines counts parsed `author ` records. Missing file: {status: "error", message: string} and exit 2. Nonzero git blame: {status: "error", tool: "git", message: string} and exit 1. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. Missing Git executable, 60-second timeout, or other subprocess exceptions are uncaught and may yield a traceback instead of JSON.
limitations: returns only aggregate counts by author display name and discards commit hashes, emails, timestamps, line numbers, source lines, and per-line attribution
author names are not canonical identities; identical names can merge and one person using different names can split across keys
does not analyze repository-wide history, infer code ownership or responsibility, compare revisions, or mutate Git state
uses the file's parent as `git -C` and an absolute file argument, applies a fixed 60-second timeout, does not truncate output, and does not catch timeout or executable-not-found exceptions

output_contract.description: JSON summary containing one file path, total parsed blame lines, and blamed-line counts grouped by author display name, or a path/Git error.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: summarize blamed line counts by author for one Git file
get a coarse Git blame authorship distribution
negative_intents: retrieve per-line blame details, commits, dates, or author emails
analyze full Git history or determine definitive code ownership
delete branches, commit changes, or otherwise mutate a repository

output_contract.description: JSON summary containing one file path, total parsed blame lines, and blamed-line counts grouped by author display name, or a path/Git error.
